planSummary: Realigned Story 2’s checkpoint path so artifact identity remains project-scoped while later revisions append new artifact versions with explicit process provenance, and updated the in-memory/read-model paths to derive current summaries from the latest durable version state.

changedFiles.reason: Removed artifact-row process ownership from checkpoint persistence so revising an existing project artifact keeps the same artifact identity and writes a new version row instead.
Aligned the in-memory platform store with Story 2 by deriving artifact summaries from latest version history and avoiding ownership-style rewrites during checkpoint persistence.
Preserved producing-process display provenance when artifact review content loading degrades into an error state.
Added durable-state coverage for multi-process revisions keeping one artifact identity while recording separate version provenance.
Added server coverage proving project-shell artifact summaries resolve currentVersionLabel and updatedAt from the latest durable version.
Strengthened artifact review assertions so producing-process provenance remains visible in normal and degraded responses.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/artifacts.test.ts tests/service/server/project-shell-bootstrap-api.test.ts tests/service/server/artifact-review-api.test.ts tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts --environment node

findingsFixed: Removed the Convex artifact-row reassignment behavior that let later checkpoint revisions overwrite artifact ownership semantics.
Aligned in-memory shell/material artifact summaries with latest artifact version history so later revisions stay current even when producedAt ordering differs from durable version creation order.
Preserved producing-process provenance labels in degraded artifact review responses instead of dropping them when content fetch/render fails.
Fixed the post-change formatting issue surfaced by the first green-verify run and reran both verification gates successfully.

recommendedNextStep: Proceed to verification against AC-2.1 through AC-2.3 using the passing green-verify and verify-all gates plus reviewer spot-checks on multi-process revision flows.
